adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts the code changed from a single calendar reference (find) to multiple references (filter) and now iterates `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. The recurring-event deletion block (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings) { ... for (const updBooking of updatedBookings) { ... calendar?.deleteEvent(...) } }`) is inside that per-reference loop. Since that block deletes events for *all* `updatedBookings` across *all* calendar credentials, executing it once per reference will duplicate the same deletions (and push duplicate promises into `apiDeletes`), causing repeated API calls and potential errors when trying to delete already-deleted events.
